scope: All three unique original pinned full-runtime images; two PostgREST containers reuse the same image. Model from verified public layer tar metadata, without saving layer contents.
limitations: Model, not daemon physical/quota measurement. Identical compressed-layer prefixes are counted once; one identical prefix snapshot is shared and counted once. Compressed digest prefix dedup is a metadata model; daemon diffID/chainID and physical allocation remain unmeasured. Existing PostgREST image allocation is already part of used root space. Inodes, xattrs, per-container writable files, import transient copies and runtime DB/Storage data add overhead.
next: Environment owner must confirm Docker writable mount/quota and safely reclaim resources outside this task if authorized; no repeated full-image retry in present confirmed resources.
